title: Reverse a String
problem: Read one line of text and print it backwards. For example, stressed gives desserts.
starter_code:
# Read one line of text.
# Print it backwards.

# Write your code here

hints.1: The last letter has to come out first. Think about reading the text from the other end.
hints.2: You can build the answer by going through the letters from the last one to the first, or use slicing with a step of -1.

failure_explanation: Every character must appear in reverse order, including spaces, capital letters and digits, which keep their case and value. A single character reads the same both ways, so make sure your code does not fail on very short text. Print the reversed text on one line.
